1.content:
# 🌍 EasyTrade — Customer Conversion & Reach
Frontend conversion funnel, error rates, and global reach based on real user session telemetry (RUM).

10.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "easytrade-frontendreverseproxy"
| summarize activity = count(), by:{geo.country.name}
| sort activity desc
| limit 10
10.title: Activity by Country

11.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "easytrade-frontendreverseproxy"
| summarize sessions = count(), by:{browser.name}
| sort sessions desc
11.title: Browser Mix

12.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "easytrade-frontendreverseproxy"
| summarize sessions = count(), by:{os.name}
| sort sessions desc
12.title: Operating System Mix

2.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "easytrade-frontendreverseproxy"
| summarize unique_sessions = countDistinct(dt.rum.session.id)
2.title: Unique Active Sessions

3.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "easytrade-frontendreverseproxy"
| fieldsAdd phase = arrayElement(splitString(event.type, "."), 3)
| summarize started = countIf(phase == "start"), finished = countIf(phase == "finish")
| fieldsAdd conversion_pct = round(finished * 100.0 / started, decimals:1)
3.title: Overall Conversion Rate (%)

4.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "easytrade-frontendreverseproxy"
| fieldsAdd phase = arrayElement(splitString(event.type, "."), 3)
| summarize started = countIf(phase == "start"), errored = countIf(phase == "error")
| fieldsAdd error_pct = round(errored * 100.0 / started, decimals:2)
4.title: Overall Error Rate (%)

5.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "easytrade-frontendreverseproxy"
| summarize countries = countDistinct(geo.country.name)
5.title: Countries Reached

7.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "easytrade-frontendreverseproxy"
| fieldsAdd action = arrayElement(splitString(event.type, "."), 2), phase = arrayElement(splitString(event.type, "."), 3)
| summarize started = countIf(phase == "start"), finished = countIf(phase == "finish"), by:{action}
| fieldsAdd conversion_pct = round(finished * 100.0 / started, decimals:1)
| fields action, conversion_pct
| sort conversion_pct desc
7.title: Conversion Rate by Action (%)

8.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "easytrade-frontendreverseproxy"
| fieldsAdd action = arrayElement(splitString(event.type, "."), 2), phase = arrayElement(splitString(event.type, "."), 3)
| summarize started = countIf(phase == "start"), finished = countIf(phase == "finish"), errored = countIf(phase == "error"), by:{action}
| fieldsAdd conversion_pct = round(finished * 100.0 / started, decimals:1)
| sort started desc
8.title: Funnel Detail by Action
